profiles.Summary: Stellaris is a grand strategy game with modest GPU demands — its CPU simulation load is the real bottleneck, especially in late-game with large empires. The Steam Deck handles it well at medium settings with a stable 40–60 fps in early-to-mid game, though late-game simulation slowdown is unavoidable on any hardware.

ProtonDB reporters rate it platinum, indicating it runs smoothly under Proton with minimal fuss.
